title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Referring to and Applying the Provisions of the Supreme People's Procuratorate and the Ministry of Public Security on Standards for Filing and Prosecuting Criminal Cases under the Jurisdiction of Public Security Organs (II) in the Trial of Economic Crimes
keywords_en: criminal cases under the jurisdiction of public security organs
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Reference to the Provisions (II) of the Supreme People's Procuratorate and the Ministry of Public Security on Standards for Filing and Prosecuting Criminal Cases under the Jurisdiction of Public Security Organs in the Trial of Economic Crimes

Fa Fa [2010] No. 22

To all local people's courts at various levels, all military courts, all railway transport intermediate courts and basic courts, and all courts of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

On May 18 of this year, the Supreme People's Procuratorate and the Ministry of Public Security issued the Provisions (II) of the Supreme People's Procuratorate and the Ministry of Public Security on Standards for Filing and Prosecuting Criminal Cases under the Jurisdiction of Public Security Organs (hereinafter referred to as "Standards II"). Standards II stipulates the standards for filing and prosecuting 86 types of criminal cases under the jurisdiction of the economic crime investigation departments of public security organs. In order to properly carry out the trial of economic crime cases, timely and accurately combat economic crimes, and effectively maintain the order of the market economy, the following notice is hereby given on matters relating to the reference application of Standards II by people's courts in trying economic crime cases:

1. Where the Supreme People's Court has not provided for the conviction and sentencing standards for the relevant economic crimes, the people's courts may, when trying economic crime cases, refer to the provisions of Standards II.

2. If, in the course of referring to and applying Standards II, the people's courts at all levels consider that the relevant provisions of Standards II cannot meet the needs of case trial, they shall, in light of the specific circumstances of the case and local realities, prudently and properly handle the application of law and policy to the case in accordance with the law, striving for better social results.

3. On the basis of further summarizing trial experience, the Supreme People's Court will formulate specific provisions on the conviction and sentencing standards for relevant economic crimes that are urgently needed in judicial practice. Prior to this, guidance for the trial of economic crime cases by people's courts will be strengthened through relevant work conferences, judicial documents, and the publication of typical cases, so as to continuously improve the level of trial of economic crime cases and better serve the needs of economic and social development and the lawful punishment of economic crimes.

It is hereby notified.

June 21, 2010
